comparison.objective: Clip a spring-gate carabiner onto a steel staple.
comparison.physical_skill: Use the staple to open the gate, pass it into the loop, and release after closure.
comparison.success_condition: Staple is enclosed, gate closed, carabiner supported, hands clear, and stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Spring-gate insertion and linkage do not overlap adjustable-stop locking.
